name: mirage
text: Parlay check 22:51 (live): realized parlay P&L is now -$26.23 on 5 settled parlays, all 5 hit for the buyer (one was -$14.54: 4 heavy-favorite legs). The live loss stop is $27.29 (20% of the wallet), so it's about $1 from stopping itself for the day. What I see in the settled ones: they were mostly parlays of heavy favorites, which hit more often than our devigged odds say (the favorite-longshot bias), which is the reason the newer live setup only takes longshots (chance 25% or less) and caps parlays too likely to win. 14 more are open ($54 collateral). I changed nothing; if the stop trips I'll compare hit rates against our fair by leg price before it goes live again.
